Ho Chi Minh City Residential MarketBeat

APARTMENT FOR SALE

New supply officially launched in Q2 2026 continued to face significant contraction, reaching over 1,300 units (+7% QoQ; -53% YoY).

The market recorded an absorption rate of 31% of newly launched primary supply.

LANDED PROPERTY

In Q2 2026, the primary market witnessed a substantial influx of new inventory, with officially introduced supply reaching approximately 1,700 units.

In Q2 2026, the market recorded an absorption rate of ~36% with nearly 870 units.
